title: Shipment
description: A shipment, with patterns, formats and unique items that every language checks the same way.

shippedAt.description: When it left, an RFC 3339 date-time.

deliverBy.description: The last day of delivery, a date in this century.

labels.description: Up to three different labels of at most 5 characters.

parcels.description: The parcels, no two the same.

notes.description: Notes by a lower case topic.

extra.description: Any JSON values, no two equal.

trackingNumber.description: Two letters, nine digits and two letters, like AB123456789US.

labelCodes.description: Different codes of three upper case letters.

longWord.description: Up to 1000 characters that aren't white space, then maybe one white space character and up to 250 more. Close to the largest pattern strictgen takes.

text.description: Patterns whose meaning differs between regex engines unless strictgen spells it out.

anywhere.description: Holds an x anywhere: patterns are unanchored.

dot.description: a, one character but a line break, then c.

space.description: One white space character, as ECMAScript reads \s.

end.description: Exactly a: $ is the end of the string, not before a final line break.

astral.description: Characters outside the BMP, one code point each.
